item.title: Court orders Fire Service to compensate woman firefighter denied training given to male colleagues in landmark case
item.description: A female firefighter has won €10,000 in damages after a court found the Fire Service discriminated against her by forcing her to wear boots three sizes too large for three years whilst denying her training that male colleagues received.
